column4: Tracks the joining tasks for one new employee. Submit it once they are done. See [Employee Onboarding](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-onboarding).
Tracks the exit tasks when an employee leaves. Submit it once they are done. See [Employee Separation](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-separation).
A course you run for employees, with its trainer and what it covers. See [Training Program](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/training-program).
Employees by branch, department, designation or grade.
A reviewer's ratings and comments on an employee for the cycle. See [Employee Performance Feedback](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-performance-feedback).
A measurable target for an employee, tracked against a KRA. See [Goal](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/goal).
One employee's ratings for a cycle. The cycle can create these for everyone in it. See [Appraisal](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal).
Each employee's goal, feedback and self appraisal scores in a cycle.
The KRAs and rating criteria for a role, with their weightage. See [Appraisal Template](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-template).
The review period, and the employees and templates in it. See [Appraisal Cycle](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-cycle).
An area an employee is measured on, such as quality or delivery. See [Appraisal Template](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/appraisal-template).
The financial year that tax is calculated over. See [Payroll Period](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/payroll-period).
How gratuity is calculated from years of service. See [Gratuity Rule](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/gratuity-rule).
The tax rate for each range of income. See [Income Tax Slab](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/income-tax-slab).
How an employee splits their flexible benefit amount across components. See [Employee Benefit Application](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-benefit-application).
Taxable income, exemptions and tax for each employee in a payroll period.
The investments and expenses an employee plans to claim against tax. See [Employee Tax Exemption Declaration](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-tax-exemption-declaration).
Proof of what was declared, so the exemption counts in the final tax. See [Employee Tax Exemption Proof Submission](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/employee-tax-exemption-proof-submission).
The date on which Salary Component with Amount will contribute for Earnings/Deduction in Salary Slip.

If enabled, the value specified or calculated in this component will not contribute to the earnings or deductions. However, it's value can be referenced by other components that can be added or deducted.

If selected, the value specified or calculated in this component will not contribute to the earnings or deductions. However, it's value can be referenced by other components that can be added or deducted.
Liability account credited for employer contributions. Applicable only for Employer Contribution components, where Account is debited as the expense.
Salary slips starting on or after this date will be considered for arrear calculations
The earnings and deductions that make up a salary, and how each is calculated. See [Salary Structure](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-structure).
An earning or deduction on the salary slip, such as Basic or Provident Fund. See [Salary Component](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-component).
Creates salary slips for everyone in a period and books the salary. See [Payroll Entry](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/payroll-entry).
Every salary slip in a period, component by component.
A bonus, arrear or deduction for one payroll period. See [Additional Salary](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/additional-salary).
Puts an employee on a salary structure with their base pay from a date. See [Salary Structure Assignment](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/salary-structure-assignment).
Bundle leave types into a policy
How many days of each leave type an employee gets in a year. See [Leave Policy](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-policy).
How much of each leave type every employee has left.
An employee's request for time off. Their leave approver approves and submits it. See [Leave Application](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-application).
The days an employee can take of a leave type in a period. See [Leave Allocation](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-allocation).
A kind of leave, such as casual or sick, and its rules. See [Leave Type](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/leave-type).
The weekly offs and public holidays your employees get. See [Holiday List](https://docs.frappe.io/hr/holiday-list).
